column_description: CHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each artifact record (e.g., 'ART000012').
VARCHAR(100) providing the artifact’s name or label (free text, no strict list).
VARCHAR(50) indicating the historical period/era/dynasty (e.g., 'Ming', 'Song', 'Qing', 'Han', 'Tang', 'Yuan'). No strict enumeration.
INT denoting the artifact’s approximate age in years (any integer value).
CHAR(30) showing the artifact’s primary material (e.g., 'Stone', 'Textile', 'Bronze', 'Jade', 'Wood', 'Ceramic', 'Paper'). Could be enumerated by your policy but often open-ended.
VARCHAR(150) describing the artifact’s current conservation condition. Possible values might include 'Excellent', 'Good', 'Fair', 'Poor', 'Critical'.
